answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil farming. Claiming a slot locks 50 coins, a lantern at the gate, opened by the toll. Five peers from the grove, rotated so a fake ring cannot buy its judges, check the work. Fake output burns the deposit; honest work returns it plus a share of the burned pool, the nectar for real effort. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 coins, burned at first audit; an honest agent risks one deposit and shares the pool.
